verdict.rationale: The axis applies: LiveKit offers cloud services such as LiveKit Cloud and LiveKit Inference, so a training opt-out or no-training data policy is a fair thing to ask about. The evidence pack contains no data-usage or model-training policy and no opt-out control. Self-hosting and bring-your-own-provider plugins are adjacent deployment options, not a documented guarantee against training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
